note: On Brazeau Reservoir about 60 km southwest of Drayton Valley on Hwy 620, run for Alberta Parks by Westward Bound Campgrounds. Loops A and B are treed; Loop C is a large gravel lot with few trees beside the reservoir. Boat launch and fish-cleaning station; no motorized vehicles on the beach, and OHVs are not permitted in the campground. --Claude
summary: Alberta Parks page (updated May 27, 2026), booking site and campground map read. Confirmed $28 unserviced / $36 power, season May 8 - Sep 19 (2026), all sites reservable. Changed sites 50 -> 49 (31 unserviced + 18 power), wrote 30-amp power in Loop C only, max length 75 ft, vault toilets, non-potable pump. No dump station or showers listed.
flags: PHONE: entry has none. The Alberta Parks page gives 'Information: 1-855-721-3975' and 'Facility Operator: Westward Bound Campgrounds'.

WATERFRONT RE-AUDIT LEAD (stored lakefront; recommend a downgrade): on Esri imagery the RVs in powered Loop C park along the south edge of the gravel lot about 30-35 m from the water, with a strip of trees on the bank between lot and shore, not open ground (imagery estimate); Loops A and B are under continuous canopy, where pads cannot be made out. The booking site tags no individual site 'Near Water' (only the two group areas). Agency wording: Loop C 'has few trees and is more like a large ...' gravel lot; nothing says the sites are on the water. By the gate this reads lakeview at best, pending a site photo that shows the water.

PIN: 52.9663,-115.5900 is about 110 m north-east of Loop C, by the manager site; Loops A and B are 450-650 m west on the same road (agency directions point 52.968097,-115.598478). Inside the campground; no move needed.

2027: shop.albertaparks.ca shows 'Status: Closed through Thu May 06 2027' (so a May 7, 2027 opening); no 2027 closing date is published. The stored season (May 8 - Sep 19, manual) is the 2026 one and still matches the agency page.
OHV: the page says 'OHVs are not permitted in the campground'; nothing describes it as part of an OHV trail system.
West Canal (9 unserviced sites + 1 tent, 40-57 ft on the booking site) is the PRA's other campground and already has its own entry (8922).
